srList.sentence: A simple random sampling method was applied to select the controls by using the sampling frame of the controls obtained during the occurrence of the event (cases) that had happened.

srList.sentence: Sample Size Determination and Sampling Procedures A double population proportion formula was used to determine the sample size by using EPI Info version 7.2.1 by considering the following assumptions: power (80%), 95% Confidence Level (CL), case to control ratio (1:3), 10% non-response rate, exposure among controls, (80.1%), and COR=0.48.20 A total of 468 study participants, with 117 cases and 351 controls, were included in the study.
